content.title: 2026 Kentucky Derby Tickets Packages | Bucket List Events
content.text: Join Bucket List Events in Kentucky and enjoy an amazing weekend of parties, people watching, bourbon, fashion, and Derby tickets for thrilling horse races. Our 2026 Kentucky Derby tickets packages include it all.We offer 2026 Kentucky Derby tickets packages that include convenient hotel accommodations, Buffalo Trace tours, race day transportation, a variety of options for Derby tickets, and more. For those looking to enhance their Derby experience in Louisville, consider upgrading to a Turf Club Seat. The Turf Club gives you a VIP track experience you will not regret. You also may want to consider adding tickets to the the Barnstable Brown Party, one of Derby’s most exclusive star-studded events happening every year on Derby Eve.Your Kentucky Derby tickets packages and add-ons will treat you to the experience of a lifetime. Join us! What’s Included? Our 2026 Kentucky Derby Tickets Packages give you the experience you’ve been dreaming of your entire life. All packages include the following: Three-night hotel stay: Select from 3 great hotel choices! Reserved seats for the 152nd Kentucky Derby (Saturday): Choose your ticket category All-inclusive food and drinks on Derby Day Experience Kentucky Tour (Friday): Visit Buffalo Trace distillery plus Lane's End horse farm, with lunch included Welcome Drinks (Thursday) Kentucky Derby welcome gift Roundtrip transportation to Churchill Downs on race day Optional experience add-ons (i.e. Brownstable Brown Gala) On-site assistance from Derby experts Book with Confidence Policy included All-Inclusive Pricing: No added fees at checkout Package Pricing and Booking Terms All standard packages are three nights. Check-in on Thursday and check-out on Sunday, giving you the perfect opportunity to experience the Kentucky Derby and the supporting festivities, as well as all that Louisville, Lexington, and the surrounding Bourbon Country have to offer. Additional nights may be added based on availability.Packages are quoted per person and based on double room occupancy and Derby ticket level . Maximum room occupancy is four people. For larger families, or other custom room or lodging needs (i.e. single or triple occupancy), please contact our team and we will be happy to assist you. If you need help understanding the difference between Derby ticket seating options, click here Derby Tickets: Seating Options Our 2026 Kentucky Derby Tickets Packages include your choice of four excellent seating options for Derby tickets. The Derby is a full day of races, so which ticket level you choose will determine a lot about your Derby Day experience at the track. All food and drinks, including alcoholic beverages, are included in the ticket options below:1st Floor Clubhouse (113-117): Open-air “boxes,” these are chairs arranged in groupings of six. They are located close to the finish line and close to all the action.3rd Floor Grandstand (323-325, covered): The third floor offers a better, higher view of the track. These are chairs in groupings of six, arranged in open-air, railed-in “boxes.” In row C and higher, you will be covered and protected from rain or sun.3rd Floor Clubhouse (312-322, covered): This area is located closer to the finish line and offers excellent people-watching. You have access to the Third Floor Clubhouse, which includes bars, betting windows, and a variety of concessions. These are chairs in groupings of six, arranged in open-air, railed-in “boxes.” In row C and higher, you will be covered and protected from rain or sun.Turf Club (VIP, indoors): The Turf Club is ideal for guests seeking a premium, VIP experience. This area features a premium chef-curated buffet, premium bars, and an upscale atmosphere with celebrity sightings. These are indoor, climate-controlled seats with plenty of betting windows. 2026 Package Dates:Check In: Thursday, April 30 | Check Out: Sunday, May 3 2026 DERBY PACKAGE OPTIONS & PRICINGHoliday Inn Express (Louisville)Galt Hotel (Louisville)Grady Hotel (Louisville)1st Floor Clubhouse(113-117)$4,795$6,295$7,7953rd Floor Grandstand(323-325 – covered)$5,395$6,895$8,3953rd Floor Clubhouse(312-322 – covered)$6,195$7,695$9,195Turf Club(indoors – VIP)$10,495$11,995$13,495 *NOTE: listed pricing is per person, based on double room occupancy, and covers ALL package inclusions.Single Occupancy– Listed Pricing +50%Triple or Quad Occupancy –Contact our team – Email: info@bucketlistevents.com OR Call: 1-512-261-5140 Hotel Options Our 2026 Kentucky Derby Tickets Packages include your choice of three excellent hotel properties.About the Holiday Inn Express: Stay in downtown Louisville and avoid paying a premium for larger hotels during the Derby. Combining modern hotel amenities with Southern hospitality, guests at the Holiday Inn Express will enjoy daily breakfast and convenient access to attractions on Main Street, like the Louisville Slugger museum.About the Galt House Hotel, Louisville: Stay in the heart of downtown at Louisville’s only waterfront hotel along the banks of the Ohio River. Located just steps from 4th Street Live and all the top Louisville attractions, the Galt House is conveniently located next to the KFC YUM! Center and close to the Kentucky International Convention Center. Churchill Downs is just 15-minutes away. Start your trip in style on the 25th floor at Swizzle, the city’s most picturesque dining spot, and enjoy prime steaks, cool cocktails, and panoramic views.About the Grady Hotel, Louisville: Blending modern amenities with the spirit of Kentucky, this new property offers a bold and distinctive stay in downtown Louisville. Just steps from Whiskey Row and less than 5 miles from Churchill Downs, guests can enjoy all that downtown Louisville has to offer. The Grady Hotel offers a boutique feel with modern rooms, and exceptional service. Want to extend your stay? No problem! Make plans to arrive early or stay an extra day.Additional Nights are available: Select “I want to book additional nights” when checking out online and our team will contact you to extend your stay in Kentucky once your package is confirmed. Booking Options & Terms Bookings & Payment Plans: For balances not paid in full at the time of booking, a deposit plus a payment plan will be required. Payment plans require a minimum $250 deposit per person at the time of booking and the remaining balance will be split into monthly, interest-free payments with the final balance due 90 days prior to the event date. All payment plans must remain active and in good standing until balances are paid in full. MyBucketListEvents reserves the right to cancel any booking that has a payment plan that is more than 30 days past due. No refunds will be given for past due cancellations.Booking Conditions: MyBucketListEvents offers event tickets and travel packages with a variety of travel services including, but not limited to, tickets, accommodations, transportation services, meals, excursions, special event access, trip planning, and on ground support. Travel insurance is not included but highly recommended and is the responsibility of the customer. With regards to event tickets, no responsibility is accepted by MyBucketListEvents or its agents in respect to opening acts, substitution of performers, athletes, or teams, relocation of seats by the event promoter, security, camera crews, or other agents at the venue. MyBucketListEvents is in no way officially affiliated with the official box offices or associated agents, event organizers and sponsors, or the participating teams, organizations, venues or associations.Book with Confidence Policy included with every package: If the Kentucky Derby is cancelled or postponed, the value of your package is protected and will be automatically applied to the new dates or to the following year, based on your preference. You will also have the opportunity to use these funds as a credit towards any other event that Bucket List Events offers between now and the end of 2024. Don’t wait, our space fills up quickly. Book today with confidence.Cancellations: Bucket List Events understands that flexibility is the key to planning your travel experiences. Whether life gets in the way and your plans need to change, or if you simply need a flexible payment plan to help you budget your expenses, we keep things flexible with the following cancellation and booking terms. But the best part was the service provided by Ben and the team. His ability to troubleshoot, go beyond the call and pivot with weather conditions is second to none. Ben’s attention to detail was commendable. This experience exceeded all of expectations! Everything was planned, well thought out and executed. We made many friends. Mike was a fabulous tour guide! Fun! Although a Bucket List item- I can’t wait to do it again ! Our Kentucky Derby weekend couldn’t have been more perfect! The accommodations were great, the horse farm and bourbon distillery tours were an absolute blast, and the Barnstable party was one of the best we’ve ever been to. It was a weekend full of fun, laughter, and memories we’ll never forget. We booked the Kentucky Derby through Ben at Bucket List events this year and had an absolutely amazing time. We would not hesitate to use Bucket List Events for any of our adventures. The guys at Bucket List Events were great. Complete professionals that made the entire experience extremely special. I would 100% use them if I returned to the derby or any other bucket list event I plan in the future. Perfect trip!!! First time to the Kentucky Derby and it was the best!! Bucket List events made the trip easy and fun. If I could rate over 5 stars. I would. Thank you all at Bucket List Events - especially you Ben! “I’ll be back.” Our trip to the Kentucky Derby was absolutely incredible, thanks in large part to the expert planning and hospitality of Ben from Bucket List Events. From start to finish, everything was seamless, enjoyable, and memorable. On Friday, we had the pleasure of touring a beautiful horse farm and an iconic Kentucky distillery. The horse farm tour gave us a behind-the-scenes look at the world of thoroughbreds, with knowledgeable guides and a chance to see some truly majestic animals up close. The distillery stop was equally impressive—filled with history, craftsmanship, and, of course, some delicious tastings. Derby Day was the highlight, and our Club Level seats made it an extraordinary experience. The view of the track was fantastic, and the amenities in the Club section made the day comfortable and luxurious. The energy and pageantry of the Derby are unlike anything else, and being able to take it all in from such premium seats made it even more special. Ben was a fantastic host—friendly, organized, and always available to ensure everything ran smoothly. We never had to worry about logistics; we could just relax and enjoy. We can’t recommend Bucket List Events enough for anyone looking to experience the Kentucky Derby in style. This was truly a bucket-list trip come to life! A big shout out to Bucket List Events. Thank you for guiding us through the ticketing process and securing us fantastic seats for the Derby. You definitely went above and beyond. We had an amazing weekend! I highly recommend Bucket List Events! Thank you for showing our group a fantastic time! Every activity was well organized and so much fun!
